label: Bil system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Bil bacterial ubiquitin-like conjugation locus that can covalently attach a ubiquitin-like protein to the bacteriophage central tail fibre and impair phage infectivity.
observations: Bil branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual ubiquitin-like proteins, E1 and E2 conjugating enzymes, deubiquitinases, central-tail-fibre modification, impaired phage infectivity, source database rows naming one Bil model, unresolved Bil HMM or rule rows, and other phage-defense systems.
